QUOTE: The library also ships its own allocator, `MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C`, which uses a caller-supplied buffer. Its init function, `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` (`library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`), zeroes a static heap, then calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` with its own functions.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init installs itself via the setter, but never says it is the only in-tree user of that setter.
